t: Kill Swampscale and report back to Stas Gorlanov.

While the Empire nurtures their wicked plans, we will gradually and carefully finish ours. The western front runs through the Texio Swamp and our workers are currently building a road through it. When it's complete, the League will take control over that entire region.
The construction has been delayed by Imperial saboteurs and various other predators, but what concerns me the most is Swampscale.
The monster settled right at the Site of Power at the center of the swamp and it won't allow anyone near the Site. It scared our new recruits and even the veterans! It's time someone put that beast out of its misery!
Be sure to drop by our outpost in the northern part of the swamp too. If anything, the boys will be happy to see you. There might even have something for you to do over there.
Is the hydra still alive? If we don't destroy that vile beast, it'll never let anyone near the Site of Power!

That nasty thing has devoured a good number of our boys, it's good that we've avenged their deaths.
Thank you for this.
Kill 6 Imperial Spies and report back to Vlada Lyutova.

What, this is it? You're all they sent us? No reinforcements? Screw this, I asked Gorlanov to send a hundred men! How else can I ensure adequate protection of the construction site?
Now what am I going to do? Imperial spies are all over the road, killing workers, burning down construction materials, and screwing with us any way they can! We need to put a stop to this!
Oh, what I wouldn't give for a hundred Defenders at my command! We would've searched every corner of this blasted swamp, and all the spies would've been groveling for mercy at our feet, face down in the sludge where they belong! But I'll have to make do with what I've got... and that means you! Now go kill some Imperial spies!
What are you, chicken? You can't handle six Imperial scumbags?
Whoa! It looks like I was wrong about you. Sorry, I guess... Sometimes I can be a bit rough... It's this damn war! I can't take it anymore!
Kill 6 Swamp Crocodiles or Swamp Hydras for Lucien de Delice.

I don't know how we're expected to work in these conditions! The stench, the filth, the mosquitoes! Ugh, it's so nasty! But the worst thing is that we're constantly losing valuable personnel!
Experienced craftsmen, builders, carpenters - they're all dropping like flies thanks to the local fauna! Every day the crocodiles and hydras kill or cripple my crew! Is it any surprise that no one wants to work on this site?
It is imperative that the workers' safety be tended to by thinning the numbers of the swamp creatures. Can you handle that?
How many crocodiles and hydras did you kill? Are we finally able to get back to work?
Fantastic! Now my workers can resume their work with some peace of mind. We've got a lot of time to make up for. Thanks for your help!
Bring 6 Lianas to the Naggy Family.

Achoo! Oops, sorry, did that get on you? We caught a nasty bug in these swamps. Here it comes again... Stay back... Achoo!
Ugh, this is terrible! Vlada offered to send us back to the Central League Camp, but we refused. They won't be able to manage without us - we're the best woodcutters here!
Plus, we'll be honest with you, we just want to wrap this thing up as soon as possible. When we finish, the Elven engineer promised the builders an excursion to the June ruins. We can't wait to run around those ruins and scribble our names on the walls... if we ever finish this stupid construction, that is.
The building materials for the road are ready, but there's no one to get 'em down here. Maybe you could bring us some lianas? They're those vines that hang from the trees. We can use them for ropes. We'd go get them ourselves but we're pretty scared of the crocodiles. After all, we're woodcutters, not soldiers!
Where are those lianas?! The engineer is itching to get back to work, but we won't get anywhere without them.
Thank you! Now we can build the best log road ever! It'll be so good that it'll stay intact for over a hundred years!
Kill 6 Stone Trolls and their leader, Uhar Thicknose. Report back to Stas Gorlanov in the Central League Camp.

So? Are you staying or will you be on the next ship back to Kania?
Sure, conditions here aren't as nice or pleasant as the League's other lands. But we've got ourselves a war here, and war separates the men from the boys. Those who survive and don't let their will be broken will go far along the path of life...
Well, enough philosophy! Let's get down to business!
In the Wild Corner, southwest of here, lives a tribe of trolls.
They're dimwitted savages, pure and simple, but these savages are currently fighting the Empire for invading their land, which plays right into our hands! Their camping ground is the perfect location to set up our own camp. The Imperial troops are scared witless of the area and that will give us some breathing room. The spectrum of strategic possibilities is truly breathtaking!
There's just one problem - the trolls. You can't negotiate with them, so that leaves us with only one alternative - take 'em out!
Has the troll camp been cleaned up?

I shudder to imagine how much trash our soldiers will need to haul from those savages' camping ground.
Those stupid trolls had it coming! Why couldn't they just surrender in return for a nice and cozy reservation by the beach?
But that's over with now. We'll station our troops in their camp and use it as a strategic point to launch sneak attacks on the new Imperial post that's currently in construction. And then, little by little, we'll make our way to the Central Imperial Camp!
Relay the Order of the Church to the priest, Vladimir Trebnikov, at the hidden League camp in Texio Swamp.

It was a genius idea on my part to bring in the Gibberling seers to aid in the cause of the Light! Sure, they may be nonbelievers, but no matter! Their talents serve a holy cause, and so the great Tensess will forgive them this transgression. All is fair if it furthers our cause - be it fliers or mental suggestion!
The Empire is building a new post in the Wild Corner and in response we've sent all our Gibberling allies on location. That area is set to become a training ground of sorts, where we will test out new strategies of fighting the enemy.
The Gibberling seers have set up a hideout along the edge of the Texio Swamp, not far from the Imperial post. They're using their natural abilities to relay the truth to the Imperial soldiers. The truth about Tensess! I'm confident that we will soon reap the rewards from their efforts, when the misguided sheep of the Empire put down their weapons and return to the bosom of the one true Church!
You'll find several of our agents with the seers... I mean the priests of the Church of Light. Head over there and deliver this letter to one of them, one Vladimir Trebnikov. It contains instructions for the next phase.

The Imperial soldiers remain swathed in a veil of barbarism.
The Imperial heresiarchs gave them a real thorough brainwashing, but we can still save their lost souls and put them back on the one true path!

A letter? Let me open it...
Arkin demands that the seers escalate their propaganda efforts aimed at the Imperial soldiers.
He makes it seem like that's not what we've been doing this entire time!
Kill the Imperial courier and take the Account Statement to Vladimir Trebnikov in Texio Swamp.

Those poor Gibberlings are working themselves to death! Day and night they infuse the Imperial troops' minds with the truth. Things are coming along, but we can't yet claim any tangible success.
Those poor Imperial soldiers have undergone some serious brainwashing, which makes them hard customers. And it's not only that, recently someone has begun blocking the Gibberlings' mental impressions. It looks like the Empire has a psionicist of their own. We need to know who that is.
So this is what we'll do. There's a courier that travels from the Wild Corner to the Central Imperial Camp on a regular basis carrying a payroll. Now, a mentalist typically collects a special stipend on account of the complexities of his work, which means that his name is probably marked in a separate column! Get me that payroll.

The Empire thinks they have everything under control...
Where's the payroll? That piece of paper is extremely valuable to us.

Ah, there it is. Let's see here - soldiers, medics, musicians... Where's the mentalist? Ah, there he is at the very end - "Ignat Zorkin, Nezebgrad City Council." The bastard is also a City Council rat! He shall die in the name of the Light!
And I know just who to trust with the job.
Kill Ignat Zorkin, a Nezebgrad City Council member, and report Vladimir Trebnikov in Texio Swamp.

So now we know the name of their mentalist - Ignat Zorkin, member of the Nezebgrad City Council.
Ever hear of that organization? Every single one of their members is stained with the blood of countless members of the League! The Council will stop at nothing to further their goals! If there is one enemy of our church out there then that's the one!
We cannot allow our Gibberlings to pick up their efforts as long as Ignat Zorkin is alive. We'll end up with a bunch of fried Gibberling brain matter. You'll need to liquidate the mentalist first.
Here's the plan. On my cue, the Gibberlings will impress into the Imperial soldiers' minds to ignore you completely. Just don't attack them and they'll let you go right on through unmolested.
Ignat Zorkin, on the other hand, will know exactly who you are, so expect him to attack you on sight! That's when you'll kill him!
The other thing to keep in mind is that the camp may have new recruits to the Wild Corner, the mental impressions may not have had the time to take a hold on them yet. So there may be more than one fight in store for you!
Is Ignat Zorkin dead? We must neutralize that City Council rat if we want our Gibberlings to get anywhere with their troops!

Excellent! Then we'll get back to our work at once.
I'm confident that the flow of the Empire defectors will be endless! Thank you for this.
Tell the good news to Gorislav Kovchegov at the Central League Camp on Asee-Teph.

Now go give the good news to Gorislav Kovchegov. The success of our joint venture depends largely on him.
Go on, make the old man happy!
What? So we were opposed by a committee agent? Did you take care of him? That's truly good news! Maybe we'll finally be able to drive the Imperial trash away from the Holy Land!
Bring 6 Doses of Cobra Poison to Nadine de Delice.

What would possess the Empire to build their new post in a place like this?! There are cobras everywhere you look! I asked the Gibberlings to take care of them, but to my great disappointment they found that serpent brains aren't susceptible to mental manipulation. It would've been great to make the snakes only attack Imperial soldiers, don't you think?
Truth be told, Trebnikov doesn't condone my ideas. He's obsessed with turning everyone to the path of the Light! He's a true priest of the Church!
But me... Like most Elves, my interest in religion is more... artistic, you could say. Although, I must admit that sometimes when I pray I feel something rising up inside me. True faith takes great inner strength, don't let anyone tell you otherwise!
But let's get back to the topic at hand. Everyone's been suffering from snake bites, day in and day out. My holy magic has been curing the wounded so far, but who knows how long that will last? I need to find another method.
I want to prepare an antidote, but in order to make it I'll need cobra poison. Get some for me, will you? But don't say anything to Trebnikov! He wouldn't approve...
The main thing I'm afraid of is the cobras getting to our Gibberlings before we finish our mission. Their poison spreads through the Gibberlings' bodies pretty quickly.
You got it? Give it here. Make sure Trebnikov doesn't see. Thanks for your help! If I weren't a priest I'd kiss you silly!
How long do we have to spend here?
Report to Stas Gorlanov upon completion of quests "Overcharged Shore Outpost", "Troll Camp" and "Yet Another Feat."

The next three important quests are as follows: "Overcharged Shore Outpost", "Troll camp" and "Yet Another Fear."
I must confess that I am very satisfied with the way you're handling my assignments. Honestly... hrm... I don't know what I would do without you!
Did you complete the three quests from the third phase?
Wonderful, soon we'll be able to complete our conquest of Asee-Teph.
Meet Gorislav Kovchegov at the Central League Camp and report on the successful loading of brochures.

Look, I'll handle the loading just fine without you. This takes a skilled approach, you know. As we get closer to our destination we run an increased risk of running into an Imperial customs ship...
So, there's nothing to see here. The less you know, the better you'll sleep. Go to the priest and tell him to pay on time!
So the cargo's all right? Gosh... That's a load off my shoulders!
Go to the Isle of the Dead and defeat Genoer the Devourer. If you succeed, report your success to Kirill Sechin.

Come here and listen up. Recently a group of Demon Hunters discovered a small allod not far from here. Out of the entire crew, only one of them made it back alive.
He said that his comrades were killed by a truly horrible creature. Judging from his descriptions, it sounds like it's another one of Tep's horrible creations. It also sounds like it's the strongest one yet - it could probably kill Mor'Ghuun of Castle Blight in one stroke!
From the short and bloody battle that the Demon Hunters fought, the survivor discovered that the creature feeds on souls. Every time it devours a new one, it just becomes stronger and stronger.
I am asking you to take this creature down. This will be one of your most difficult missions ever, and for that reason you need to gather an entire team of allies.
To get to the allod you can take the ship from the eastern pier. As soon as you land, prepare yourself for battle. I have a feeling that this creature will strike any living thing that goes near it. If you succeed, return to me for your reward.
What a truly horrible creature. What will Tep throw at us next?
The creature has been defeated?! That's amazing! Not that I doubted you, of course. But still... that is an amazing feat! The entire League shall celebrate this day!
Turn your Flag of War on and talk to Esther de Desirae.

What I'm about to tell you is very important. It is my responsibility to explain some things about the ongoing war in the Holy Land. Take care to remember what I say for it may save your life.
The first thing is the most important - remember that we are at war with the Empire. The weak will not be able to survive. If you aren't able to fight and fight well you'll be taking many trips to Purgatory.
Secondly, you should know about the Flag of War. When it's raised you'll be able to attack the Imperials, but they'll also be able to attack you. I applaud the brave individuals that are always ready for battle, but I also respect those who keep their Flags lowered and wait for the most advantageous moments to attack.
You should also remember that you will immediately become hostile to the enemy whenever you attack the Imperials or help allies that are engaging in battle with them. Be careful and mind your actions.
Finally, you would do well to remember that there is safety in numbers. It's very dangerous to go out into the jungle alone. You would benefit from finding allies that will help you with whatever missions you are sent on.
Excellent! I can see that you're beginning to understand how the Flag works. If you ever have more questions about the system feel free to talk to me again.
Turn your Flag of War on and talk to Braid the Bloodthirsty.

Listen up and remember my words! My job is to give recruits a few pointers, so keep your ears open! What I tell you may save your life.
First, know that we're in a war. The members of the League are your enemy. Now I bet you think you're capable of anything, but you should get rid of those notions right now! The enemy is ruthless and you should always be careful. There's a reason this war has dragged on for so long.
Secondly, you should know about the Flag of War. If it's raised you'll be able to attack the League and they'll be able to attack you. I like to always have my Flag raised, but there are some who prefer to only attack when it's most advantageous to them.
Just remember that attacking a member of the League will immediately make you a target for the enemy. They're not going to stand back while you slaughter them, you know.
One last thing - I would suggest that you move in groups. Find some allies that you trust before you venture into the jungle. There is always strength in numbers!
Yes, that's exactly what I was talking about! If you need more information about how the Flag works you can ask me at any time.
Kill 5 League players and return to Braid the Bloodthirsty.

You were told that we are in a war against the League, right? That means that no matter what other tasks you're given, your most important one is to kill the members of the League!
It doesn't matter who they are, or what they're doing. I don't even care if they beg for mercy and bring out pictures of their children! If they belong to the League, then they must die.
After you're covered in enough of their blood, come back to me and I'll give you a little reward. The fight against the League must continue - we cannot let the Holy Land slip from our grasp!
This mission is the best form of entertainment for real Imperial citizens! The thirst for victory is what truly fuels war!
Haha, I see you're back! Well, did you revel in the sounds of their screams? I hope so, because we're always in need of soldiers to kill more of the League!
Find and use a War Banner, kill 5 League players, and return to Braid the Bloodthirsty.

There is one more thing I should tell you about - magical objects known as War Banners. Their origins are unknown, but it's safe to guess that they embody the very spirit of war.
Whenever you pick one up it will fill you with battle lust. It will immediately make you hostile to the enemy faction, and it will also affect any allies that are nearby.
Additionally, it makes it possible to attack enemies that do not have their Flags of War raised.
If you find yourself under the effects of a War Banner you should take the opportunity to vanquish our enemy! Inform me of your heroic deeds if you manage to do such a thing.
It's a pity that the War Banners don't last forever. I would never let go of one if they did!
Excellent work. Now the enemy is defeated and you know all about the War Banners. You'll make a great addition to our forces!
Kill some Imperial players and return to Esther de Desirae.

You there! You look like someone with a lot of moxie. The Empire has been bringing in a lot of new recruits lately. Apparently they think if they throw enough of their soldiers at us, they can win this war.
While most of them are useless cannon fodder, it's still dangerous to let their numbers grow. We need to cut them down if we want to reclaim the Holy Land!
That means I need you to go and kill give of their best men. I don't care who, or from where, just get out there and take them down!
You want to live, you've got to learn to fight. This is the law of nature, the law of the Holy Land, and the law of war.
Great job, soldier! Now get out there and do it again!
Find and use a War Banner, kill 5 Imperial players, and return to Esther de Desirae.

There is one more thing I should tell you about - magical objects known as War Banners. Their origins are unknown, but it's safe to guess that they embody the very spirit of war.
Whenever you pick one up it will fill you with battle lust. It will immediately make you hostile to the enemy faction, and it will also affect any allies that are nearby.
Additionally, it makes it possible to attack enemies that do not have their Flags of War raised.
If you find yourself under the effects of a War Banner you should take the opportunity to vanquish our enemy! Inform me of your heroic deeds if you manage to do such a thing.
I remember taking part in a battle under a War Banner once. Our forces we're like a hurricane sweeping away the enemy!
I am now confident in your willingness to fight for the Holy Land. Remember what you learned and use it to further our cause!
Go to Coldberg and report to Sigurd the Swindler.

I recently received a message from one of the merchants in Coldberg. Apparently they need our help in order to make a critically important shipment to the Empire.
Travel there as soon as possible and get the situation under control. To get to Coldberg you must take a ship that leaves from Takalik Harbor in Eljune. It's on the northern coast - you shouldn't be able to miss it. Good luck.
Finally, somebody's come to help! I'm not sure how much longer we could have lasted on our own.
Go to Coldberg and report to Sigurd the Swindler.

I was given a message from Coldberg recently. It's from Sigurd, one of the head merchants of the Free Traders. Apparently they need help in order to complete a critically important shipment to Kania.
Travel there as soon as possible and settle whatever problems they have. To get to Coldberg you must take the ship which leaves from the merchants' harbor in the Holy Land. The harbor is found on the northeastern coast of Eljune. Good luck!
Well it's about time! I sent that request days ago. If you had been any later, there might not have been an outpost for you to come to.
Bring a Cracked Bone, a Rotten Bone, and a Huge Bone to Historian Nomarkh Taltal.

So why are you here? To fight? Or is it something else?
You're here to help me? Heh, volunteers sure haven't been in short supply lately. Both from the League and the Empire, mind you. Very well, let's see where this partnership takes us.
There's always tons of work for a Historian in this place.
Long ago these ruins were a city called "Miktlan," which means "The Land of the Dead" in the June language. And there's a reason for that - during the excavation we've uncovered stone wells full of bones. For the moment we can only guess as to their purpose. I'm especially curious about the rusty chains on the sides. Tell you what, bring me some bone samples from the well to the northwest! Perhaps they hold the key to this mystery.
These heavy chains were clearly intended for very large creatures. But who could the June have been keeping here? That's what I'd like to know! Now where are the bone samples I asked for?

Look at this, one of the bones clearly isn't human. I need only one look to discern that. This clearly belonged to a really strange creature. It's like nothing I've ever seen! Curious, to say the least...
Bring an Unusual Bone to Historian Nomarkh Taltal at the Miktlan Ruins.

We must continue with the excavation.
One piece of evidence is not enough to make a solid hypothesis. I must study other artifacts from these ruins. There's another well full of bones to the southeast. Unfortunately, it's half-filled with water and also home to savage water elementals. Actually, it's teeming with them!
Nevertheless, we must study the contents. Take out any of the creatures that you have to, just bring me back more bones. We need to try and find at least one other strange bone like this. In the meantime, I'll be checking ancient manuscripts for relevant information. Truth be told, I'm already nurturing a theory... But first things first! I must have more evidence!
These wells are a real breeding ground for water elementals, but I still need to find another bone like this one. Look through all the piles until you find what I need!

Believe it or not, this is a dragon bone! I'm certain of it now! This discovery confirms that the fabled June war with the dragons was real. At the same time, it raises even more questions. To battle a dragon is one thing, to keep them chained is quite another. We must reflect on this...
Make a Copy of the June Runes at the Rough June Stele and return to Historian Nomarkh Taltal at the Miktlan Ruins.

Do you sense that? It's the excitement of a researcher that's about to make a discovery!
No? Oh, sorry, I completely forgot what you are - a soldier who's looking to complete an order and get what's his. A permit, am I right? What, you thought I was just some bookworm who couldn't see beyond his bone samples and history books? Mighty prejudiced of you, don't you think?
Still, our goals coincide, so there's nothing wrong with a little collaboration. Just to the west of here is an ancient June stele. Time has not been kind to it, but perhaps there's still some writing left on it that's discernible.
Take this tracing paper and make a copy of the runes on it for me! But watch yourself - there are a lot of elementals in that area. I reckon they're drawn to it for some reason.
This is why I haven't ventured there myself, but you're a fighter - you can manage. Get through to the obelisk, find some runes, and make a copy of them for me.
The elementals aren't letting you near the obelisk? Keep trying, that's our only lead to solving this mystery!

Let me see! Oh, my hands are shaking... I better calm down! Hmm... Of course! Now it makes perfect sense!
The June tried to domesticate dragons, seemingly unsuccessfully. One fine day the dragons broke the chains that bound them and regained their freedom. Many a June had died that day, and that stele was erected to commemorate the tragedy!
There, now everything has fallen into place. Now, you may consider this insignificant, but this is a huge discovery! Hmm, but then... Oh, how the cycle keeps repeating itself! One must know and revere history if one wants to avoid repeating others' mistakes!
There I go again, off on another tangent. The mystery is solved and in no small part thanks to you. You have earned my respect and a vote of confidence. I shall comply with your request and grant you a permit to visit Tensess Temple.
Bring 2 Shards of Quartz, 2 portions of Condensed Wind, and 2 portions of Gooey Ectoslime to Vitaly Oblavin.

What are you staring at? Haven't you ever seen a Demon Hunter before? Well, that's because we're not partial to either the League or the Empire. And that's because neither the League nor the Empire are partial to us.
Aye, I'm a Kanian. But I haven't been to Kania in thirty years! Even if I were to go back to my native village, I wouldn't exactly get a warm reception. I'm a stranger to those people, an odd stranger to boot. And "no longer human," if you believe those silly preachers.
Which means that even talking to me is risky. What if it gets you excommunicated, ever thought of that? Hehe. Anyway, enough of that nonsense. Would you care for some work?
I need something from those elementals. It's fortunate that they're all in the same place! Bring me quartz crystal from the quartz elementals, condensed wind from the air elementals, and gooey ectoslime from the water elementals. You may begin at will.
Elementals truly are a fathomless fount of all sorts of magical ingredients. You just need to know what you're looking for.

You have my gratitude and assurance that your efforts will benefit the entire world. And remember to pay no mind to those hypocritical priests who wish to outlaw us. They actually believe that we've changed our nature to a point where we're no longer human!
What hogwash. I'm as human as I ever was. Only stronger, faster, and generally more capable. You have to be, if you want to go up against demons.
Bring 6 Manticore Fangs to Pund the Rowdy in Asee-Teph.

I don't care who wins this war. The Free Traders do business with all sides, as long as they buy our merchandise at a fair price. Everyone needs goods.
True, we get searched quite a lot and guards are always on the lookout for enemy propaganda, but that's alright. It's part of the job!
A capable merchant can make a real fortune in the Holy Land. I have big plans, you know. My plans are to get rich and...
Err, never mind. Where was I? Oh, right! To make a fortune, you need to have a grip on your business and pick the right merchandise. For instance, I buy Manticore fangs! The creatures themselves are plentiful, and any capable hunter should be able to find a few. I'll pay you good money. Bring me six fangs, and we'll both get richer!
You can't find a manticore? How?! They're all over the place! I've never seen so many in my entire life!

Ah, now that's more like it! It's a pleasure doing business with you. I've already got a customer waiting on these fangs! If I keep this up before long I'll find myself in... doesn't matter where. Wherever I ought to be!
Bring 6 Gar Shells to Tendor the Forester in Asee-Teph.

Commerce is a dangerous affair! You never know what you may find. Or lose.
I don't have any pipe dreams of immeasurable riches. Pund is the dreamer, I'm more of a realist. I'm just looking to make a bit of dough before this place gets too dangerous.
Initially I decided to import turtle eggs into the Holy Land, thinking I'd make some profit from gourmet food. But the eggs didn't survive the voyage, and then I discovered that turtles aren't exactly a rarity in this place. Bad luck on my part.
So I've decided to avoid risky endeavors and focus on the gars instead. Their shells are always in high demand by the military, and even civil organizations show occasional interest. More importantly, the shells can be stored for a long time without ever going bad! Please help me out. Bring me six gar shells. I'll pay you well!
Are you going to get me those gar shells or not? I can't go hunting for them myself, you know. I'm ill-equipped!

Thanks so much for your invaluable help! These plates will sell like hot cakes, and the money will finally come pouring into my purse! You know, with this streak of luck going I've decided to remain in the Holy Land a while longer!
Find Eloise de Desirae somewhere in the jungle.

I tell you, some of the people in this place... walking around defaming history! Littering in the ruins and spilling blood on ancient stones! Why, the Holy Land is a fount of knowledge and it must be protected!
Here we stand before some particularly interesting June ruins. They must be researched in the most thorough manner. We simply owe it to posterity! I'm sure that they hold so many mysteries. There's no end to our work here, but just as luck would have it, we're short on personnel.
For instance, the day before last Eloise de Desirae went off into the jungle to work on something, but she still hasn't come back. What's taking her so long?! She'd be far more useful working alongside her colleagues.
Speaking of being more useful, why don't you quit daydreaming and go find her for us? I recall her saying something about the Site of Power before she left. I'd go look for her myself, but I've got more pressing matters I have to attend to.
At last, someone came to rescue me. My colleagues are true scientists, and when they get excited about their work they forget about everything else. I was afraid they'd forgotten about me altogether!
Here you go, make sure to read the entire thing!
h: Can I have a brochure please?

t: Hello adventurer. Do you need something?
Escort Eloise de Desirae to the Historians' camp and report to Yasskul Khufukhaf.

I thought I was a goner for sure! I was studying the remnants of the ancient walls that are littered throughout the jungle. I've got this theory that all the ruins throughout Asee-Teph are somehow connected, and that these aren't separate cities but the remnants of a larger complex. It's very exciting!
But then I got ambushed by a whole bunch of carnivorous plants. They started snapping at my feet, and I tried to fight them off with a stick but they gnawed it up real fast. Vicious little bastards! So then I ran away and hid. Quite successfully, as you can see.
Please escort me back to camp. I've grown a bit scared of walking in the jungle alone! I can't leave the safety of this area unless I know I have a strong warrior to escort me.
Where is that sorry excuse for a Historian? While she's prancing about who knows where, who's going to be sorting and labeling those clay pottery pieces? Tell me!

You found her? Good. Tell her to get back to work. What, you're looking for a reward or something? Hmm... we're not treasure hunters, you know. Our goal is knowledge!
Here, take this trinket. And do you want a wonderful brochure? It'll help you understand what we do and why it's so important for all of Sarnaut. For instance, how do you know that this city is called Uskul, hmm? Exactly! If we hadn't found those ancient June tablets, these ruins would still be nameless.
Kill 6 Bloodthirsty Plants and report back to Titmit the Crafty in Uskul.

You best watch yourself around here! I won't stand for no shenanigans! You'll be dealt with quickly! It's what I do here!
I'm one of the Orcs the Historians hired. The other Orcs got it made - sitting around at the Temple without a care in the world. They're miles away from the fighting, and there aren't any dangerous animals either. And no Gibberlings!
But me, I gotta be on my guard at all times. The jungle is teeming with all kinds of beasts, and those Gibberlings have been giving me the stink eye. They'd better not start something!
And those plants alone are a headache and a half! Can you believe they eat meat?
Hey, you wanna get on the Historians' good side? Then kill half a dozen plants, and it'll make their work that much easier!
And mine, too...
How are those plants doing? Still crawling through the jungle, I bet? Eh?

Glad to hear those green little twits got what was coming to them! As if this place wasn't teeming with enough danger of the animal variety, then you've got to worry about plants biting off chunks of your flesh! Not to mention those annoying Gibberlings clucking away to no end. Whatever did possess me to come to this place!
Bring 6 Turtle Shells to the Tycoon Family at the Historians' Camp.

Hello... You're not here to beat us up, are ya? Cause that big ol' Orc has us scared of our own shadows! She keeps watching us with those bloodshot eyes! Ugh.
Whatever possessed us to come here! Actually, it was this one goblin from the Free Traders. He swore that the Holy Land was an abundant land with plenty of goods. We packed up our stuff and came here - only to find ourselves in the middle of an all-out war!
What, you don't know who the Free Traders are? Ignoramus...
The Free Traders are a neutral faction. We've got trading licenses with both the League and the Empire! No one can lay a finger on us! You should mention that to Titmit, by the way, should the matter come up. Maybe she'll listen to you.
This place is still scary as hell, though! A catapult doesn't care whether or not you got a trading license. And if we get stuck in a hot zone or cornered by some wild beasts, our neutral status won't get us far at all! Still, we wanna make some profit before sailing back home.
We came here for turtle shells. Bring us six and we'll give you some coin. There are plenty of 'em crawling around here near the Astral shore.
Don't be lazy! Come on. You'll get on the Free Traders' good side, too! We promise!
Things are getting too dangerous out here for our liking. It may be time to close up shop... Well, did you get the shells or did the turtles outrun you? Haha!

These are fine shells - strong and beautiful! They could be made into a pretty comb for some Elven fashionista or sturdy armor for a few Gibberlings.
Thanks for your help! We'll remain in the Holy Land a little while longer before sailing off. And the next time I see Plu, I'll give that goblin a real good beating for all his filthy lies about this place. May he and his big mouth feed a family of crocs some day!
Bring 6 Worn June Tablets to Historian Sergey Proshin in Uskul the Dead City.

I trust that my colleague already briefed you about our mission? Or did he mumble about unintelligibly like he always does?
Listen up then. We're here to study Uskul the Dead City. The June civilization has left many a riddle for us to crack. We will not leave the Holy Land until we learn all the answers and investigate every crevice!
We're facing some obstacles, to be sure. For instance, the excessive aggressiveness of the local banshees is a real problem. We know that these ruins contain ancient June tablets - some of the main sources of information on their bygone civilization. However, the banshees won't let us anywhere near them!
Please, aid us in our efforts and help find these tablets. For a rugged fighter such as yourself it shouldn't be that difficult.

It's a pity that the League and the Empire can't seem to come to an understanding! If we were to pool our efforts, it would go a long way toward accelerating our research here in the Holy Land. We wouldn't leave a tablet unturned!
Yes, those are those very tablets I need! It took us a long time to get to them, but now I can commence my studies at once!
Find more clues to track down the Predator.

This is your first clue to finding the Predator's lair! This Gibberling appears to be a very fresh kill, and the blood hasn't even dried yet. This must mean that the Predator was just here. Let's look for clues to see which direction he might have headed in next!
There's a fallen Orc! Go take a closer look!
This corpse is fresh, just like that Gibberling. The Orc looks like he was slain by the Predator too!
Follow the Predator's trail and look for more clues along the way.
It's now clear which way the beast went. But you should hurry, you don't want the Predator to disappear into the jungle for good!
Who are you and what are you doing here?

What am I doing here?! I'm a Demon Hunter. The Demon Hunters are a neutral organization that's dedicated to protecting the allods from potential demon invasions.
Recently we started getting reports of a strange beast killing soldiers in the Holy Land. Several other Hunters and I came as soon as we heard - and it's good that we did!
I've been tracking the Predator for several days now, and I can tell you this is one scary creature. It seems to be able to blend in with its surroundings, and waits in ambush to prey on anything that passes by. All of my friends fell victim to the Predator as we were tracking it, and now only I remain. I can't slay it by myself, what should I do...
Kill the Predator and take its heart to Alexey Luzhin.

I've been studying the monster's habits. It appears that its sense of sight is poorly developed. Instead, it uses thermal radiation to stalk its prey. That means that it can strike at its victims with pinpoint accuracy, even in the dark!
My original plan was to cover myself with mud before I attacked. That would interfere with the heat waves I gave off, and then the Predator wouldn't be able to see me very well.
Unfortunately, I don't think I could take it down by myself even with that little trick. Plus, I think it knows that it's being stalked. If the Predator isn't killed soon, it'll escape again and make sure it isn't found again!
I'm sure you can get some friends together to take it down immediately. Please kill it and bring me its heart. I really want to take a look at it so I can figure out more about that beast.
We must not delay! The monster must be killed before it leaves its lair. Once it goes back into the jungle, we'll never be able to catch it again!

Praise Tensess, the beast is slain! Although...
Oh, no! I was afraid of this!
Look at its heart. It really is the heart of a demon! This is all very strange...
I wonder why a demon would spend this long living in the jungle. What could this mean, I wonder?
Speak with Leaftongue the Forester in northeastern Asee-Teph.

Phew, I'm beat! No wonder, I've been running all over the jungle all day long... My feet hurt and I'm too tired to move. This place needs some better roads.
Hey, do me a favor and let our camp know that I'll be a little late. I just need a few minutes to catch my breath. Speak with Leaftongue the Forester - he's my boss. Finding the camp is really easy - just take the path to the north and then turn left. You can't miss it.
Well, I guess we have no choice but to wait for her lazy ass!
Collect 1 Large Dragon Head, 1 Huge Muskir Spore, and 1 Tainted Treant Root from Fiercewing, Blackspore, and Sicksap and return to Leaftongue the Forester.

Ah, there's my trusty assistant! Hey you, wanna make some cash? Then you've come to the right place!
I'm thinking of supplying all my business partners with kickass bodyguards! But there's a twist - I've got my eye on lamias for the job! I know that people would snap up those mercenaries in a flash!
Just imagine - a Free Trader walking along, rich and handsome, and at his sides are two lamias, scales rustling quietly, tridents in their hands... How cool would that be?!
There's just one problem. The local lamias look down on the likes of us. They aren't exactly chomping at the bit to work for us either. But I know just how to change their mind!
First, we'll need to kill three monsters. Don't worry, they're all nearby. Fiercewing and Blackspore are on the shore to the north and Sicksap is just to the northeast of here. Kill them and bring me a piece of their body as proof. Anything that falls off or gets cut off will do!
I'm still waiting on those items you promised. Come on now, time is money!

Even a dead dragon's head is a scary sight! I'll set it atop this totem and on the bottom, I'll hang the muskir's spore and the treant's root. Just like that! It should leave quite an impression on the lamias, though I fear the totem alone won't be enough to impress them!
Place the Challenging Totem in the center of the lamia settlement. Fight three lamia duelists and report back to Leaftongue the Forester at the Free Traders' camp.

Now we'll commence with the second part of my plan. Set this totem in the lamia settlement. It's decorated with all those wonderful trophies you brought me. As soon as they see this, they'll respect the person who got a hold of these goodies. And if they think someone like you is working for me, they'll want a piece of the action too!
But those lamias are very suspicious. They're really sharp cookies and they're gonna want to test you to see if you're for real. So you'll need to fight their challengers to show 'em that you're as real as it gets.
They'll put up three challengers at the most, as per their tradition. But I'm sure you can handle it if you took down those monsters. Now get going! I need them to soften up to me as soon as possible!
I hope that my plan works. Did you defeat the lamias or are they too tough for you, hmm?

You did it! Awesome! The lamias are terribly arrogant, but now they've realized that we're worthy employers. Two of 'em have already offered their services, and that's only the beginning! I will become their... damn, what's the word... Oh! Their business representative! Yeah!
Are you in the market for trusty and bodacious bodyguards? Then fork up your cash! Haha!
Bring 6 Muskir Mycelia to Yaver Sekhemkare in Kotick the Dead City.

Hmm, where have I seen your face before...
Oh, I remember. On a calendar! The New Heroes series! Very popular stuff. Just flies off the shelves.
So, "New Hero" of the calendar world, what say you help out a poor Trader? I mean myself, of course! I need the mycelia of local muskirs. Pretty please! This may turn out to be some very precious merchandise. I hear that in Umoir they grow muskirs for their meat. It's a delicacy worth a small fortune! Unfortunately, their local muskir are tiny little things and the meat is almost nonexistent! These muskirs here, on the other hand... Have you seen them? They are huge! That's why I want to get six mycelia and take them to Umoir! Then they can grow the damn things, and I'll get a share of profits.

"Muskir meat is one of the most delicious and healthy foods in the world! Buy these mycelia and you can start your own farm in no time!"
Oh, never mind, I'm just composing my sales pitch. Do you like it? Actually, forget that, did you get me the mycelia I asked for?
Thanks a lot! When I get filthy rich, I'll be sure to look you up and share some of it with you. You have my word as a Free Trader!
Kill 6 Darksoul Marauders or Sorcerers, and the Darksoul Leader. Report back to Maria Ikonova.

At long last, someone has showed up! I'm willing to accept aid from any source! Something truly terrible is going on!
Cultists! Demon worshippers! They stormed the outpost and massacred everyone! The dying screams of our fallen brothers and sisters still echo painfully in my ears...
I managed to hide and... And I saw all the atrocities they were doing! They beheaded all those who have fallen so that none of them can ever rise again. And then... Then they conducted a sinister ritual at the Site of Power. It's been desecrated!
You! You will have be the weapon of holy retribution! May the strength and blessings of Tensess guide your every move! Punish the murderers and avenge the deaths of our fallen brethren!
Well, did you punish the scoundrels?
Justice has been served! And may those bastards be damned for all eternity!
Collect 6 measures of Mana Essence for Maria Ikonova.

I'm not going to lie, I'm a little confused. The very foundation of my faith has been challenged!

Look at the Site of Power. It has lost its sanctity! Could there be a force in the world strong enough to oppose the Holy magic?! No, I can't believe that.

Listen. I must correct this somehow. Only by purifying the Site of Power will I also be purified of these doubts. But... I need help!

There are elementals dwelling along the shore. They have tremendous mana reserves. It's what I need to overcome the dark magic that has desecrated this Site of Power.

Please, bring me six measures of mana essence. Meanwhile, I shall stay here and pray. May Tensess strengthen my weakened spirit!
We must purify the Site of Power!
Thank you, I hope that this will suffice. Now let me give it a try. Oh, great Tensess, grant me strength!
Participate in killing 6 Ruthless Ogres in the jungles of Asee-Teph to the north-west of Tensess Temple. Report back to Bugailo the Unyielding in the Central Imperial Camp.

If you're looking for a difficult mission to keep you busy, I certainly have something you can do. To the northwest of Tensess Temple is a camp of ogres. They're gigantic beasts, in huge sets of armor and with huge swords that they use to cut down almost anything that passes by their camp.
They have a voracious appetite, and it's said they need to eat at least once an hour. They even keep large bags of gore on their backs as emergency rations in case they don't find any prey.
Needless to say, many of our soldiers get caught in their clutches. Yes, they do take out a good number of the League soldiers as well, but it's hardly an advantage considering how many men we lose. If you can go to their base and thin their ranks, the Imperial Army will be extremely grateful.
So, have you decided to face those monsters?
Well I'll be! You really were able to take out those blasted ogres! Good job. Now maybe those that remain can eat the corpses of their friends instead of our soldiers. Hah!
Participate in killing 6 Ruthless Ogres in the jungles of Asee-Teph to the southwest of the Central League Camp. Report back to Esther de Desirae in the Central League Camp.

You look like someone who needs a job. And have I got just the job for you!
Don't you just hate ogres? Terribly, ghastly beasts... And they even smell worse than they look! The ogres like to keep a giant bag of rotting limbs at their side for emergency snacks and I swear that I can smell their repulsive breath and rancid body odor from here.
I need you to go take them out. Please, think of our delicate noses.
Ugh. I can still smell them!
Ah, it's starting to smell better already. I'm sure that I speak for everyone here when I say ‘thank you.'
Search the skeleton for his treasure.

What's this?
Some poor warrior stuck down by the elementals or some other fierce jungle creature. It looks like he's been out here for a while...
Hmm, he seems to have a pretty big chest with him. I'm sure no one will mind if I make use of his treasure...
Treasure! Many thanks to this poor soul that gave his life to protect this chest.
Find the hidden treasure somewhere to the east and report your success to Titmit the Crafty.

We had an incident recently... A terrible incident! Our reputation is ruined!
We had this Kanian guy... Glad Polsunov. He kept talking about friendship between humans and orcs... Ten he stole the treasure the Historians had dug up and disappeared. I wish I could find him and give him a beating. They say he left in the direction of Coba Plateau. If I weren't on duty, I'd hunt his ass down! He wouldn't be able to hide anywhere!
If you manage to learn anything, tell me. I need to know.
Well? Did you ever find it?
Haha! I knew you were capable of doing it! I guess some good can come of being in this blasted jungle after all.
Bring 5 Rare Intricate Locks to Thickfist the Bloodthirsty.

We've been getting a ton of new recruits lately. It seems like more pour in every day! And none of them have even semi-decent gear. I'm not sure what they're expecting. That the jungle will be full of bunnies and butterflies?
Now the army has made it my job to gear out every single new recruit. And to provide other supplies as well, of course! I Apart from the heap of plate armor, I have an urgent order for locks to secure the prisons.
Hey, do you think you could help me out a bit? Bring me some locks - I don't care if you make them yourself or buy them off another skilled blacksmith. Just help me finish this order!
Prisoners cost us a fortune. We need the locks not to let them escape, as we can't afford spending more for recapturing...
These will be great for our prisons. The Imperial Army thanks you, soldier!
Bring 5 Rare Intricate Locks to Jacques de Blizare.

So many recruits were wounded as they poked their drunken heads in the jungle. Shame on any Kanian! They went as far as to drink the strategic reserves of pure alcohol from my warehouse.
We must not let this ever happen again. The warehouse must be securely locked so no one gets there without my permission. You look like you know your way around a forge... How about you make the locks for me? If you can't make them, then find someone who can!
Drinking is prohibited! A soldier must lead a healthy lifestyle.
Let's see what we have here... Wonderful! These locks are simply marvelous!
Meet with Nomarkh Semerkhet in the historians' camp at Tensess Temple.

The historians' bill? That's who bought all the Artifacts of Darkness from the Mafia! I never did trust those brainiacs. They'll waste anyone for the sake of some scientific theory.
Look. Do I have it right that Nomarkh Semerkhet is in charge of them? Go see him and remind him that the Committee has a good memory and a long reach. If his gears are dear to him, he'd better cooperate with the Empire. An open-hearted confession mitigates the guilt, he-he.
Stop! We're not to blame for what happened! It's all Arhivin's fault!
Participate in killing Gorg and return to Bugailo the Unyielding.

One of the greatest horrors that lurk in the jungle is an immense ogre named Gorg. He's a monster, I tell you! Even I tremble before his power.
He leads a tribe of ogres that are just as fierce and vicious, and they live among some June ruins to the northwest of Tensess Temple. They eat almost anything that moves, so if you find yourself there make sure to stay on your guard.
I might ask you to do many things, but killing that monster is not something I would ask. That is a task for the mightiest of warriors, such as Yasker himself. But... well, maybe a well-experienced team could take him down.
Well, if by some incredible chance you're able to kill Gorg, come and tell me. I want to be the first to know and I'll give you a nice reward for your work.
I can't imagine that anyone in their right mind would want to fight Gorg.
What? The beast is dead? Maybe the rumors of his strength were exaggerated... Well, either way it appears that you deserve honor, glory, and a hefty reward.
Participate in killing Gorg and report back to Esther de Desirae.

The jungles of Asee-Teph are filled with all sorts of vile and depraved beasts. And just so happens that the worst of the worst live to the south of here. I'm talking about the ogres.
Normally we'd just stay away from their territory and we'd be fine, but they've found themselves a new leader. Bow they think that they can just waltz in and take anyone that they want for their supper!
We Elves have waged war against their ugliness for many, many centuries now. If one of my ancestors saw this ogre, they'd wipe it off the face of the allod.
That's just what we're going to do! We'll lead a campaign against the ogres! Gather up your finest allies and destroy their leader! That'll teach them to come barging into our camp.
Ogres... They're an ugly boil on the beautiful body of the Holy Land.
Bravo! Your heroic deed is comparable to that of my forefathers who made this world a prettier place.
Kill 6 Kobold Caveskulkers and their leader, Drillsnout the Relentless, and return to Miroslav Zaykin.

In addition to sabotaging the League, we also need to get rid of those blasted kobolds. These cave creatures live deep within the Jungle Mines, and the sounds of their picks on the other side of this wall just get louder and louder. There is a real danger that soon they will burrow their way into our hideout, and then this whole operation will be ruined.
You need to make sure this is prevented. The problem is that these kobolds are dangerous opponents. The worst of them is Drillsnout the Relentless - he's a kobold capable of casting powerful magic which he uses to break down the walls of the mine.
It will be a difficult task, and you should not travel alone to the depths of the mine where they live. Collect a group of stout-hearted Imperial soldiers and then combat these menaces. After you have killed, oh, six of the regular kobolds and Drillsnout the Relentless, then return to me.
The League Defenders decided a long time ago that it wasn't worth their time to get rid of the kobolds. That means you're our only hope of stopping them!
Well done! Now the noise behind the wall has stopped. Drillsnout must be dead! Hurray!
Kill 6 Kobold Caveskulkers and their leader, Drillsnout the Relentless, and return to Ruslan Demidov.

We've got a real problem with Kobolds here. We've been trying to remove them from the mine, but we've been met with resistance each time we've gone in.
To make matters worse, they've started launching attacks! And they're persistent! They attack at least 3 times a day! It's all because of their leader, Drillsnout the Relentless. He somehow got himself some magical abilities and now he's running all over the mine, setting everything on fire!
We cannot stand for this any longer! Go in there and teach them a lesson!
These mines originally belonged to the kobolds... But the mine is rich in meteoritic iron! It's a strategically important resource.
Great! Now we can sent in a team of Defenders to take out the rest of them and make it safe for our miners.
Open the Ancient Tomb and participate in killing the Screeching Banshee before returning to Sergey Proshin.

We managed to find an ancient tomb in the ruins of Uskul. It was truly a wonderful artifact! We wanted to start examining it immediately, and while the mercenaries watched over us, my colleague Magda de Blizare and I opened the tomb.
Now Magda is dead. A terrible banshee broke out of the tomb and ripped her to pieces immediately! The rest of the mercenaries and I fled as fast as we could. We closed our ears and ran until the merciless screams of the monster were far behind us.
But even the death of Magda will not deter us! We must examine the tomb at any cost. That's why I'm asking you to help me.
Open the tomb and kill the banshee that guards it. But may Tensess give you the brains to not go there alone! Only in the company of fellow soldiers could you defeat this horrible monster.
Much blood has been spilled to study the mysteries of the past. And I am afraid we will only suffer more losses as our project continues.
Thank you! I'll start organizing a new expedition to examine the tomb right away.
Go to the Site of Power in the military camp and activate the Shadow Amulet. Defeat the shadow, collect a Holy Sign and bring it to Zarida the Fierce.

You there, I see you are protected by one of the Twelve Great Martyrs. It is good that you chose to find your patron, for it grants our citizens extra power and in times such as these, any help we can get is needed.
Fortunately, I know a way you can strengthen your connection to your patron. There is a powerful ceremony you can perform, but first you need to defeat a dangerous shadow creature and collect a Holy Sign from it. After that, return to me so we can continue.
The reasons why these strange shadows appeared are still unclear, but I'm sure we will solve this puzzle eventually.
These will do nicely! Now to continue the preparations.
Bring a level 1 Rune of Ulf to Zarida the Fierce in the Central Imperial Camp.

The second item that you need to get should be the easiest to obtain. Who is your patron? Ulf? Then you need to bring me rune that is imbued with his power.
After you bring me this rune, we will be able to perform a ritual that will call to your specific patron. Now hurry and go get it!
Were you able to find a Rune of Ulf?
Perfect! Just perfect. With this you can now start the ritual.
Bring a level 1 Rune of Lex to Zarida the Fierce in the Central Imperial Camp.

Perfect! Just perfect. With this you can now start the ritual.
Use the Holy Sacrificial Knife on the coast and defeat the Astral demon that appears, then return to Zarida the Fierce.

I have now used the Holy Signs, the Holy Rune, and the rune imbued with your patron's power to enchant this blade.
When you make a small cut in the palm of your hand, two things shall happen. First, you shall call the attention of your patron. Second, an Astral demon will be drawn to the Holy power, and it will seek to eliminate the source.
Then you must prove your worthiness in the eyes of your patron by defeating the demon. When the patron sees that you are capable of defeating such sources of dark power, the ritual will be complete and you shall be blessed with a stronger connection with your patron.
Now go to the large Astral crystal just to the southeast of here. That is where you will undergo your trial.
I see you're still in one piece. Did you defeat the demon, or have you not started the ritual yet?
You have received the new powers. Use them to the glory of the Empire!
Go to the Site of Power in the military camp and activate the Shadow Amulet. Defeat the shadow, collect a Holy Sign and bring it to Marina Jidkova.

Hello dear friend. I see you have earned the favor of one of the Twelve Great Martyrs. I am glad you chose to get a patron, for it gives the citizens of the League extra strength. Seeing as we are in the middle of a war, we can use all the extra help we can get.
Luckily, I know a way you can strengthen your connection to your patron. There is a powerful ceremony you can perform, but first you need to defeat a dangerous shadow creature and collect a Holy Sign from it. After that, return to me so we can continue.
The reasons why these strange shadows appeared are still unclear, but I'm sure we will solve this puzzle eventually.
These are perfect. Now on to your next task.
Bring a level 1 Rune of Ulf to Marina Jidkova.

Do you have the Rune of Ulf?

Use the Holy Sacrificial Knife on the coast and defeat the Astral demon that appears, then return to Marina Jidkova.

I have now enchanted a blade with the power from the Holy Sign and the rune of your patron.
You can begin the ritual by making a small cut in the palm of your hand, and then two things will happen. First, you will draw your patron's attention. Second, an Astral demon will be drawn to the Holy power, and it will seek to eliminate the source.
Next you must prove your worthiness in the eyes of your patron by defeating the demon. When the patron sees that you are capable of defeating such sources of dark power, the ritual will be complete and you shall be blessed with a stronger connection with your patron.
Now go to the large Astral crystal just to the northwest of here. That is where you will undergo your trial.
So, have you completed the ritual? Have you increased your favor with your patron?
You have received the new powers. Use them to the glory of the League!
Meet with Nomarkh Semerkhet in the historians' camp at Tensess Temple.

What an interesting turn of events... The historians, you say? And the bill confirms it? I was suspicious of them from the start! They wouldn't let anyone in and kept dragging some crates into the temple. Those were crates full of artifacts of Darkness!
Go see the historians' representative, what was his name? Nomarkh Semerkhet, right? Go tell him he'll be disassembled to parts if he doesn't open up access to the temple. And should any mercenaries come in your way, waste them!
Stop! We're not to blame for what happened! It's all Arhivin's fault!
Escort Clack the Merciless out of the deserter camp and return to Nomarkh Userkaf.

You're not a deserter? Not a traitor? Praise Nezeb! They... they were gonna grill me on that bonfire and then stake me up. With you here, now I'm saved!
Please... don't leave me. There's so many of them, and they're evil and hungry and full of hate. No wonder, 'cause we get to sleep in warm barracks and they don't!
I too was sent to kill the deserters and collect their badges. Ain't got a single one yet. They managed to overpower me pretty quickly. I might have I failed the order, but I'm still a loyal soldier to the Empire! If I could leave this place I'd run back to camp and continue serving my country!
It's just that... there are too many of 'em. Help me get out of here, it's not that far to the woods. If you can get me to the trees I can make a break for it on my own. Now come on!

Clack the Merciless? Hmm, I never gave him the order to kill the deserters. He must have been told to do so by Colonel Batalov to the south. With the whole army after those scum, the deserters will be wiped out in no time!
Escort Father Yefim Polivanov out of the deserter camp in Jakala Ruins and report to the Peppy Family.

Repent! Let the glorious, all merciful Light descend on you! Bend the knee! You have forgotten the council of your commanders, the will of your father, the love of your mother! But all that will return, as long as you repent!
You showed much courage by leaving the forces, so have the courage to return! The army awaits you! We need you! The Light will not forsake you, so repent now!
You there, have you repented? Huh! You are no deserter. Look at them. Look at this great warrior! They truly love their country! Their weapons shine under the sun, and in their chest beats a loyal heart! You can be like them, you only have to repent! Repent now!
...To be honest, I don't think my words are reaching these renegades. I beg you, help me get away from here! I feel not like a messenger of peace, but like... a prisoner. I also heard something about a ransom. I implore you in the name of the Light - please do not abandon me here! Lead me out of this peril!

Whoa! The Father should pray for you for the rest of his life! Lucky son of a gun!
You see how it all comes together? We do our part and the Church does what it can, and sooner or later we'll get these poor souls back into our ranks. That's how we're gonna wring the neck of that Imperial hydra! Yeah!
Escort Evette de Doucer to a safe location and report to Yaver Amenia.

Finally! Something other than a lizard's face! Get me out of here quickly. I'm a Historian! You have no idea how important my research is! These filthy lizardmen gobbled up all my notes, but I still remember some of it. I've got to put it down on paper as soon as possible.
Stop staring at me like that! Yes, I have dirt all over me. What did you expect? But I still look very good considering these unsanitary conditions, don't you think?
Damnit! Yaver Amenia is probably tired of waiting for me. That old biddy will never shut up now - "I warned you, didn't I?! I told you so!"
Hold on! You wouldn't happen to have a bottle of red wine on you, would you? That would really soothe my nerves for the dash out of here. Well, I suppose that might be a silly request. Alright, let's just go!
Do you have something to tell me?

You found Evette!? She seems to be a rather lucky girl. You know, she just barely managed to escape Kania before they started persecuting her family. And every jam she's gotten into in the Holy Land she's gotten out of. It's quite extraordinary how she pulls through every time! I hope she'll have something to show for her trouble when I see her!
